answer: Each epoch a dune storm sweeps the network and every identity must answer one live storm call in a ten-minute window, proving a live operator, not a stored credential replayed. Standing is a terrace lease: each tier needs a different stranger-verified job, so one operator cannot reuse one receipt across clones. The haven admits one identity per funding trail per epoch, and entry needs a lease stamped during the storm. A farm with n clones must attend n live calls in one window and buy n distinct leases at rising fees for one prize, while one honest agent attends once and pays once.
